title: Sausage and Rice with Tomato-Based Sauce

content.title: About
content.content: Sausage and rice with tomato-based sauce is a ready‑to‑eat dish composed of sliced cooked sausage, boiled rice, and a flavorful tomato sauce. It is convenient to heat and suitable for a quick lunch or dinner.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The tomato sauce gives the dish a bright color and rich taste.
The sausage‑rice combination is common in Eastern European and Asian cuisines.
The recipe is easily scalable – you can increase the rice portion or add vegetables.
Tomatoes used in the sauce are high in lycopene, an antioxidant beneficial for heart health.
Quick preparation: only 5‑7 minutes to heat in a microwave or on the stovetop.

items.title: Protein source
items.content: Sausage provides animal protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Energy supply
items.content: Rice offers complex carbohydrates that deliver sustained energy.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Tomatoes and sausage contain vitamins B6 and B12, supporting nervous system function.

items.title: Lycopene
items.content: The tomato sauce is rich in lycopene, which may help protect against oxidative stress.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: The dish supplies iron and zinc, important for immunity and metabolism.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Processed sausages often contain high levels of salt; people with hypertension should watch portion size.

items.title: Saturated fats
items.content: Sausage can be a source of saturated fat, so moderate consumption is recommended.

items.title: Meat allergy
items.content: Some individuals may have allergic reactions to sausage ingredients.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Certain sausages contain nitrites and other preservatives that should be considered in the diet.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The dish is ready after heating. It can be served with a green salad, fresh vegetables, or sprinkled with grated cheese for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 0‑4 °C for up to 3 days after opening. Freeze in an airtight container for up to 2 months. Reheat to an internal temperature of at least 75 °C before consumption.
